verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no dedicated data-export feature. Devin's API and official MCP server expose session management, playbooks and knowledge programmatically, which could be used to pull data out. It also supports the open AGENTS.md standard for agent instructions, so that context stays portable. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all account data (sessions, knowledge, playbooks, logs), stated open export formats, account-deletion/offboarding documentation, and independent confirmation that exports are complete.
